import.retained: The official OpenAPI document is published by WPS on open.wps.cn without authentication and is byte-identical to the spec embedded in the official MIT-licensed CLI package @wps365-open/wps365@0.2.27. The exact bytes are retained in sources/openapi.yaml as evidence and reproducibility proof; the document has no file-level license field, so this collection relies on the official MIT package license and the public availability of the endpoint, and does not copy the official documentation site prose.

curated.note: Official curated command catalog (101 commands, 7 groups) used as stable operationId anchors.

cliPackage.name: @wps365-open/wps365
cliPackage.note: Official WPS 365 CLI published by Kingsoft (maintainer emails at wps.cn); embeds the official OpenAPI spec (api.yaml) and the curated command catalog.

license.analysis: The official spec is published publicly on open.wps.cn (no auth) and distributed inside the official MIT-licensed CLI package. The MIT license covers the package contents, including the embedded spec. This collection independently authors all bilingual prose, retains attribution (ATTRIBUTION.md), does not copy the official docs site prose, and does not imply official endorsement by Kingsoft. API usage, credentials, and data-handling obligations are governed by the WPS Open Platform developer agreement between the caller and Kingsoft.
license.verdict: An independently authored bilingual PontxSpec and a generated @pontx/wps-365 SDK/CLI can be published with these boundaries: attribution retained, no copying of official docs prose, no implied official endorsement, no Hub proxying/caching/aggregation of WPS 365 enterprise data, and caller-direct execution with caller-owned credentials.

derivation.boundary: All 826 callable operations in the official Kingsoft Office Open APIs v7 OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (806 paths / 827 operations), excluding GET /v7/oauth2/qrcode_auth_code (browser-redirect OAuth helper: official spec declares only 302+default, no JSON success contract, no official docs page, absent from the curated CLI command surface, and returns 404 Route Not Found without a browser session).
derivation.method: one-time @pontx/spec importOpenAPI conversion followed by a source-free bilingual PontxSpec curation: stable operationIds anchor on the 101 official curated command IDs (curated.yaml) and derive deterministically from method+path otherwise; explicit tags map path modules to 24 canonical controllers (sources/tag-map.json); the 15 /v7/sse/* text/event-stream endpoints declare a typed SSE contract (message event, json dataFormat, preserve unknown events) since the official document does not enumerate event names; parameter/schema/constraint/enum/example and response semantics are retained from the official document.

transport.rest: 811 plain REST operations (GET/POST/DELETE only; the official document declares no PUT/PATCH).
transport.sse: 15 operations under /v7/sse/* (aippt, aidocs, docqa, generator, wps365agent) use text/event-stream; modeled with typed SSE contract (events.message dataFormat=json, unknownEventPolicy=preserve).
transport.callbacks: Event subscriptions are encrypted HTTP callbacks (AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) pushed by WPS to the caller; they are not callable Pontx Endpoints and are documented in product.json, not modeled as endpoints.
transport.note: Per-vendor SSE event-name semantics still require final review against official docs before the transport gate is marked passed.

riskReview.mutations: many (POST/DELETE across users, messaging, mail, meetings, drive, approvals)
riskReview.credentials: OAuth2 app (client credentials) and delegated (user authorization) tokens plus optional KSO-1 HMAC-SHA256 signing; modeled as environment variables only.
riskReview.execution: All Hub execution is disabled because WPS 365 enterprise data is private business data and the developer agreement imposes integrator data-handling obligations. The package exposes caller-direct reads and writes; mutations require preview-first and exact confirmation, and no production mutation is used for validation.

quality.findings: 0 Critical, 0 Major, 0 Minor; 1 baseline i18n.structure finding from bilingual disabledReason (consistent with launched nager-date, dropbox-sign, notion products).
